about.title: About Me
about.description: As a Senior Fullstack Developer focused on the Vue/Nuxt ecosystem, I bring years of experience building scalable web applications. As a Nuxt Ecosystem Member, I actively contribute to the open-source community. Currently building jano, a modern terminal editor written entirely in JavaScript.
